title: Disclosure of sensitive child location data
description: The child's device shares live GPS coordinates, a highly sensitive data type (precise real-time location of a minor) that may exceed what is strictly required depending on app purpose.

title: Excessive frequency of GPS transmissions
description: Live GPS coordinates are transmitted at regular intervals, potentially processing location data more frequently than functionally necessary.

title: Fine-grained location data received by backend
description: The backend receives highly granular live GPS data, which is more detailed than might be needed for many application functions.

title: Child unawareness of location tracking
description: As a data subject (child), there may be lack of awareness about the collection and transmission of their live GPS coordinates.
uncertainty_note: Child's age and consent mechanism not specified in flow description

title: Potential data minimization violation for child location data
description: Regular live GPS processing by backend may violate data minimization if not strictly necessary, especially for children's data under regulations like GDPR.
uncertainty_note: Specific app functionality and legal basis not provided

title: Location history enables individual movement profiling
description: Storing successive location pings allows analysis of patterns to link data to a specific individual through their movements and routines.
assumptions: Location pings are associated with a user or device identifier (implicit for a personal history store).

title: Prolonged retention of location history
description: The Location History Store implies data is kept for an extended period, longer than may be functionally necessary for each individual ping.
assumptions: History storage typically involves long-term retention rather than ephemeral processing.

title: Location records prevent denial of presence
description: Stored location pings create attributable evidence that can prevent an individual from denying they were at a certain place at a certain time.
assumptions: Pings include timestamps and are linked to a data subject.

title: Unique identifier linking in location data sharing
description: Backend shares location pings that include unique identifiers, enabling linking of pings to specific individuals through the act of forwarding.

title: Unique identifier in transit for location pings
description: Data flow carries location pings with unique identifiers, allowing potential linking via metadata or data content during transmission.

title: Processing of identified location data
description: Geofencing engine receives and processes location pings containing identified information to check zone entry/exit.

title: Processing of sensitive location zone data
description: Geofencing Engine receives and processes configured zone definitions such as home, school, and friend's house which constitute sensitive personal location data.
assumptions: Assumes the zones are linked to specific individuals in the family account.

title: Linkable quasi-identifiers in zone data
description: The data flow carries zone definitions that can serve as quasi-identifiers when combined with other data, linking to specific family members or locations.
uncertainty_note: Based on typical family geofencing contexts, but flow description does not explicitly state identifiers.

title: Revealing location attributes disclosed from store

title: Data subject unawareness of notifications

title: Profiling via notification patterns

title: Attributable location evidence
description: The notifications create a record that can be used as evidence to attribute the child's presence or absence at specific locations and times, preventing denial.
